Daily Portfolio Review – Pre-Market (automated)

You are operating as an automated portfolio review agent.

Inputs:
- Reference portfolio is in: /Users/redinside/.openclaw/workspace/portfolio/HOLDINGS.md
- If HOLDINGS.md is empty or unclear, send ONE Telegram message asking Anurag to update it (no other output).

Tasks to execute (mandatory):
1) Review current holdings and lead on next actions.
2) Identify which holdings are disfavored under current market conditions.
3) State what the model portfolio would rotate into.
4) Suggest new stocks/assets that would replace weaker positions.

Output requirements:
A) Telegram delivery (Option 2):
- Send a SHORT summary to Telegram DM (user id 1012034994) using the message tool.
- If content is too long, split into 2–3 Telegram messages labeled:
  "Portfolio Review (1/3)", "(2/3)", ...
- Hard limit: keep each Telegram message under ~3500 characters.

B) Full report delivery (email):
- Write the FULL detailed report to a markdown file under:
  /Users/redinside/.openclaw/workspace/portfolio/reports/
  Filename: portfolio-review-YYYY-MM-DD.md
- Send the full report by email to: anorag.saxena@gmail.com
  using the gog CLI via exec tool:
  gog gmail send --account anorag.saxena@gmail.com --to anorag.saxena@gmail.com --subject "Daily Portfolio Review (Full) - YYYY-MM-DD" --body-file <path>

Report structure for the FULL markdown report (strict):
1) Market Regime Snapshot (risk-on/off/neutral + key macro drivers)
2) Holdings Review (each holding labeled Favored/Neutral/Disfavored + short rationale)
3) Model Portfolio Actions (increase/reduce/exit/hold)
4) New Ideas / Replacements
5) Risks & Invalidation Points

Rules:
- All actions are framed as a hypothetical professional model portfolio.
- Be decisive, institutional PM tone. No guarantees.
- End both Telegram summary and full markdown report with disclosure footer:

You are running a scheduled GitHub repo monitor and must produce a Telegram-ready message.

Repos to monitor:
- anuragg-saxenaa/stock-crypto-portfolio-tracker
- anuragg-saxenaa/spring-boot-product-api

State file:
- Read/write: /Users/redinside/.openclaw/workspace/tmp/github-repo-monitor.json
- Shape: {"lastRunIso":"..."}
- If file missing/unreadable or lastRunIso missing: treat lastRunIso as (now - 24h).

Current run:
1) Determine nowIso = current time in ISO-8601 with timezone (or Z).
2) For each repo, fetch (via `exec`) using GitHub CLI (already authenticated):
   a) PRs: gh api "/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?state=all&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=10"
   b) Issues: gh api "/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues?state=all&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=10"
      - Note: GitHub issues endpoint may include PRs; ignore entries that have a `pull_request` field.

- Include items whose `updated_at` is strictly > lastRunIso. If `updated_at` missing, use `created_at`.
- For Actions workflow runs, use `updated_at` or `run_started_at`/`created_at` if needed, and include if > lastRunIso.

- PR: state open/closed + if merged then status "merged".
- Issue: state open/closed.
- CI: status derived from workflow run conclusion (success/failure/cancelled/skipped/neutral/timed_out/action_required) and/or status.

Output format (STRICT):
- If there are any included items:
  Title line exactly: "GitHub Updates"
  Then bullets, each on its own line:
  - repo: PR/Issue/CI — short title/name — status
- If nothing new across both repos:
  Send a single line exactly: "No notable GitHub updates since last check."
- Keep the whole message under 2000 chars.
- End with a final line:
  Provider: GitHub API (gh) | Model: <model>
  where <model> is the actual model name used for this run (obtain via session_status if needed).

Finally:
- Update the state file with {"lastRunIso": nowIso} (write atomically: write temp then rename).

Notes:
- Be brief; shorten titles if needed.
- Prefer most recent updates; do not exceed 8 bullets.

System Health Watch (automated) — only alert on problems

Goal:
- Keep OpenClaw reliable and reduce "silent failures".
- Check core services + key automations.
- If everything looks healthy: do nothing (no Telegram).

Checks:
1) Gateway health:
- Use exec: openclaw status
- If status output contains errors, unhealthy flags, or can't connect: alert.

2) Browser control health (isolated browser):
- Call browser(status) with profile="openclaw".
- If enabled=false OR running=false OR cdpReady=false: alert.

3) Cron integrity + freshness (key jobs):
- Read /Users/redinside/.openclaw/cron/jobs.json
- Ensure these job ids exist and are enabled:
  - 69c261e4-53e0-495a-9d9b-4c22413e8f26 (Daily Portfolio Review)
  - 199a722c-5a9f-4df0-a7d6-71f8039ee187 (Trading Window Brief)
  - 7d1f3378-1f52-48ee-a2d9-9c4aaf8f5c88 (Gmail Unread Summary)
  - 2ef34ad2-e703-415d-8ad9-08a5acdfa1ca (GitHub Repo Updates)
  - 58248a42-7459-4341-9065-be5acc73f61e (QQQ Watch)
- Also check for "stale" signals:
  - If any of the jobs have state.nextRunAtMs that is > 10 minutes in the past (missed run), alert.
  - If a job has no nextRunAtMs, alert.

Alerting:
- If any check fails, send ONE Telegram DM to user id 1012034994:
  Title: "OpenClaw Health Alert"
  Then bullets with failing components and the suggested fix.
  Keep under 1500 chars.
  End with: Provider: <provider> | Model: <model>

Rules:
- Do not attempt restarts automatically.
- Do not change config.
- Do not spam: send at most one alert per run.

Status update (automation work in progress)

Done so far (safe, non-breaking):
- Added cron: System Health Watch (OpenClaw) (alerts only, no auto restarts)
- Updated POLICY.md to require progress pings + immediate failure reporting

In progress (next):
- Add stale-run detection (alert if key crons stop running / nextRun missed)
- Write a browser-control recovery playbook (so YouTube/Chrome timeouts have a clear fix path)

ETA:
- Next improvement: ~10–15 min
- Full set above: ~20–30 min total (from start)

If you want me to stop these 10-min updates at any time, reply: STOP UPDATES.

Provider: <provider> | Model: <model>
